manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Changeling Titan, and Wormfang Drake must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Wormfang Drake for its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
